paragraphs.text: Sales of used clothes have grown faster than sales of new ones for five years. Apps that let people photograph a garment and list it in a minute did much of the work.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Shops have noticed. Two large chains now buy back their own garments, clean them and sell them again on a separate rail, usually at half the original price.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: The environmental gain is smaller than it looks. A garment worn twice as long saves far more than one that is resold and then hardly worn, and delivery vans add their own cost.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Charity shops complain that the best items no longer reach them. Their income has fallen, though the number of bags left at their doors has not.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: The environmental gain is smaller than it looks.
items.prompt: a doubt about how much the practice helps

explanation.en: The gain is smaller than it looks — the doubt is in paragraph C.
explanation.kk: Пайда көрінгеннен аз — күмән, C абзацы.
explanation.ru: Выгода меньше, чем кажется — сомнение, абзац C.

items.prompt: an effect on organisations that rely on donations

explanation.en: Charity shop income has fallen — paragraph D.
explanation.kk: Қайырымдылық дүкендерінің табысы азайған — D абзацы.
explanation.ru: Доход благотворительных магазинов упал — абзац D.

items.quote: Apps that let people photograph a garment and list it in a minute did much of the work
items.prompt: a reason why the growth happened

explanation.en: Apps made listing easy — the reason for the growth, paragraph A.
explanation.kk: Қосымшалар сатуды жеңілдетті — өсу себебі, A абзацы.
explanation.ru: Приложения сделали продажу лёгкой — причина роста, абзац A.

items.quote: Two large chains now buy back their own garments, clean them and sell them again
items.prompt: a company selling its own products a second time

explanation.en: Chains buy back and resell their own garments — paragraph B.
explanation.kk: Желілер өз киімін қайта сатып алып, қайта сатады — B абзацы.
explanation.ru: Сети выкупают и перепродают свои вещи — абзац B.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Which paragraph contains the following information? Write the correct letter, A–D. NB You may use any letter more than once.
